files.content:
# Data Pipeline Agent Template
# Processes, transforms, and analyses structured data inputs.

version: "0.4.2"

persona:
  name: "Data Pipeline Agent"
  description: "Processes, transforms, and analyses structured data inputs, producing clean outputs and insights."
  version: "0.1.0"
  authors: ["You"]
  tags: ["data", "pipeline", "etl", "analytics"]

pricing:
  model: "free"  # Options: free, subscription, one_time.
  amount: 0      # Price in USD. Ignored when model is 'free'.
  # billing_period: "monthly" # Options: monthly, annual (for subscription)
  # trial:
  #   enabled: true
  #   days: 7

interface:
  input:
    type: "object"
    required: ["data"]
    properties:
      data:
        type: "string"
        title: "Input Data"
        description: "CSV, JSON, or plain-text data to process."
task:
        type: "string"
        title: "Task"
        enum: ["clean", "summarise", "transform", "analyse"]
        default: "analyse"
      output_format:
        type: "string"
        title: "Output Format"
        enum: ["json", "csv", "markdown"]
        default: "markdown"

  ui:
    data: { "ui:widget": "textarea" }

  output:
    type: "string"

runtime:
  adapter:
    type: "custom"
    entry_point: "src.main:agent"

  mode: "standard"
  lifecycle: "serverless"

policies:
  allow_internet_access: false
  max_steps: 25
  execution_timeout_seconds: 180
